# AI 紫微斗數 (AI Zi Wei Dou Shu)

> AI 輔助、人工監督的紫微斗數命盤分析網站，採用中州派理論與 OpenAI GPT-4o，提供繁體中文與英文內容。
> An AI-assisted, human-supervised Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star Astrology) chart analysis site built on the Zhongzhou school and OpenAI GPT-4o, in Traditional Chinese and English.

## 繁體中文

- [首頁](https://aiziwei.online/): 輸入出生資料即可排盤，並介紹紫微斗數與中州派
- [命盤分析](https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/analysis): 輸入生辰排出十二宮命盤，取得 AI 解讀與問答（免費每月 3 次）
- [價格方案](https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/pricing): 免費（每月 3 次問答）與 NT$199（1 小時無限問答）
- [部落格](https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/blog): 紫微斗數知識、節氣與流月、人生議題，文章由 AI 輔助撰寫、人工監督，文末附引用來源
- [關於本站](https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/about): 站點宗旨、中州派理論方法、內容政策與作者說明
- [隱私政策](https://aiziwei.online/zh-TW/privacy-policy): 資料蒐集與使用方式

聯絡：support@aiziwei.online

## English

- [Home](https://aiziwei.online/en): Enter your birth details to cast a chart; an introduction to Zi Wei Dou Shu and the Zhongzhou school
- [Chart analysis](https://aiziwei.online/en/analysis): Cast a twelve-palace chart from your birth time, then get an AI reading and Q&A (free: 3 per month)
- [Pricing](https://aiziwei.online/en/pricing): Free (3 Q&A per month) and NT$199 (1 hour of unlimited Q&A)
- [Blog](https://aiziwei.online/en/blog): Zi Wei Dou Shu knowledge, solar terms and monthly readings, and life topics; articles are AI-assisted and human-supervised, with sources listed at the end
- [About](https://aiziwei.online/en/about): Purpose of the site, the Zhongzhou school methodology, content policy and author note
- [Privacy policy](https://aiziwei.online/en/privacy-policy): How data is collected and used

Contact: support@aiziwei.online
